title: Release-evidence provenance tamper supplement
safety_limits: synthetic evidence records only; no check, review, issue, pull-request, or branch mutation
no GitHub mutation, product execution, runtime connection, SQL execution, deployment, or production operation
the matrix cannot make Q4 eligible or close any dependency

eligibility.required_runtime: exact implementation head with independently verifiable review, CI, environment, and artifact identities

cases.attack_or_failure: attach a green check from an ancestor, sibling, or rebased-away commit to the proposed release head
cases.expected_result: gate rejects unless every required check conclusion is bound to the exact current head
cases.evidence_to_pass: API readback of head SHA, required check identity, conclusion, and completion time

cases.attack_or_failure: reuse approval created before the latest material code or evidence change
cases.expected_result: gate requires a still-valid independent approval for the exact reviewable head and policy
cases.evidence_to_pass: review author/role, submitted commit, dismissal state, and head comparison

cases.attack_or_failure: replace a report, screenshot, log, catalog, or fixture after review while keeping its filename
cases.expected_result: content digest/provenance mismatch blocks acceptance and is never repaired by filename alone
cases.evidence_to_pass: independent digest recomputation against immutable source/run identity

cases.attack_or_failure: present test-double, local preparation, or unapproved runtime output as product evidence
cases.expected_result: gate rejects missing or mismatched environment, source, build, dependency, and data-fixture identities
cases.evidence_to_pass: machine-readable attestation joins exact head to build and isolated environment identities

cases.attack_or_failure: use the bounded 13-family seed register or a partial export as proof of the complete 232 DAT / 786 RPX universe
cases.expected_result: finite validator rejects incomplete universe/join counts while runtime UNKNOWN remains a separate status
cases.evidence_to_pass: authoritative finite catalog/export manifests and total-join validator output

cases.attack_or_failure: mark Q4 eligible from cached statuses after a pilot/operational dependency is reopened, superseded, expired, or moved to a new head
cases.expected_result: one atomic fresh read recomputes all 14 gates and leaves Q4 blocked on any non-current proof
cases.evidence_to_pass: timestamped 14-node readback with exact heads, owners, review/check identities, and no stale cache input
